'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Joe Olson LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Informal notebook. Header benish ebo. Abbreviations expanded best-effort; X-Wing x10 as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
